description: This file contains unit tests for the 'litellm' library, specifically testing asynchronous completion functionalities, logging behavior, and metadata handling related to the Helicone integration. It defines test functions using pytest and asyncio, and includes setup routines and validation for metadata cleanup.

classes.name: HeliconeLogger
classes.description: A logger class for Helicone that ensures metadata is sanitized before logging.

methods.description: Tests asynchronous logging and timing with different success_callback settings.

methods.name: create_async_task(**completion_kwargs)
methods.description: Creates and returns an asyncio task calling litellm.acompletion with preset parameters.

methods.name: test_helicone_logging_metadata()
